anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After keeps every fact Before kept and gains two: plain-reader moves because the unexplained shorthand in Before ("falsification test", "missing-normalization hypothesis", "tracked baseline", "no delta at checkpoint 2") is replaced by everyday phrasing such as "page not found (404)", "standard form" and "no saved preferences", and draft-asks-reporter moves because the reporter draft now has a literal What happens next section carrying the browser-and-version request (Before asked the same thing but in an unsectioned blockquote, so the section-specific fact could not hold). Claims stay grounded: the mechanism remains a comparison without normalization rather than a recast action, the fix is described as a proposed normalization with an expected outcome and kept at "small and safe" without a one-comparison narrowing, the test is described only at the specificity the case supplies, and no citations appear so none can precede a complete claim. Menu, eligibility line, closing fence and send-it confirmation are unchanged. One small wording caution for the author: After's checkpoint 1 drops all proof lines (prior-report search, clean baseline) that Before carried; the fact set tolerates this, but if you want the gate to stay auditable, add a short Context with the one repro line ("`/widgets/` returned 404; the test confirmed the missing standard-form step as the cause") rather than reintroducing the shorthand bullets, and keep the because-clause exactly one short sentence as it is now.
